growth_expectations.rationale: Slight to modest growth majority; five Districts flat/declining activity.

inflation_concern.rationale: Prices rose modestly; input costs stabilizing; some discounting noted.

labor_market.rationale: Employment rose slightly; improved labor supply; skilled-worker availability challenge.

credit_conditions.rationale: Soft demand for loans; high interest rates restrained activity.

policy_uncertainty.rationale: Elevated uncertainty around election, domestic policy, geopolitical conflict, inflation.
